Five merged PRs since 2026-04-16 added or removed a line containing `SavePatientTransactionManager` under `packages/esm-patient-registration-app/src`. Listed best first, with `mergedAt` in UTC:

1. **#2780**, merged 2026-09-28 (`b4b76423`): adds the `savePatientTransactionManager: SavePatientTransactionManager,` parameter to `savePatientIdentifiers` in `form-manager.ts`, and adds `new SavePatientTransactionManager()` calls in `form-manager.test.ts`. It also adds the `SavePatientTransactionManager` import to `patient-registration.test.tsx`.
2. **#2776**, merged 2026-09-25 (`81c24905`): removes `savePatientTransactionManager: new SavePatientTransactionManager(),` from the offline save path in `form-manager.ts`.
3. **#2786**, merged 2026-10-05 (`1aaae8c`): adds `new SavePatientTransactionManager(),` calls to the new preferred-identifier tests in `form-manager.test.ts`. Its `form-manager.ts` change does not touch the class name.
4. **#2697**, merged 2026-08-24 (`ddd67a6`): adds `new SavePatientTransactionManager(),` calls to the new deletion-await tests in `form-manager.test.ts`. Its `form-manager.ts` change does not touch the class name.
5. **#2694**, merged 2026-08-24 (`f298c04`): replaces the `form-manager.test.ts` import with one that includes `SavePatientTransactionManager`, and adds `new SavePatientTransactionManager()` calls to the new death-info tests.

Excluded after checking the diffs: #2778 (`b322ea70`), #2693 (`b62a388`), and #2784-era identifier changes that only touch other lines. Also excluded: the `form-manager.ts` changes in #2697 and #2786, and the `patient-registration.component.tsx` changes in #2776 and #2780, since none of those touch a line containing the class name.

Two gaps: I did not diff the #2532 jest-to-vitest migration (`5fc0dc3`, 2026-05-13) or #2763 (`71b3d3f`) line by line.
